items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Louie Armstrong made a record of that too, yeah.

ctx.x: Buddy Pity Band. And the time I was in Buddy Pity Band, they had one song around here that I used to sing pretty good in the band. It was a song you called Tight Like That.
Oh yeah, sure. The record came out about that time. Yeah. Well, from then on I ... Louie Armstrong made a record of that too, yeah.

From then on, what happened then, I got with a trumpet player called Robert Taylor. He's originally from New Orleans and he was a show man. I don't know anything about it. He had a show you called Taylor's Nehi Revue Show. That was in 1927. He had a show you called Robert Taylor's Nehi Revue Show. All right. So I got with his show. And we used to show at the Coliseum Theater, show around and down. We showed at the Lincoln Theater when the Lincoln Theater was on Louisiana
